# coolify_s3_storage (Resource)

Manages a Coolify backup storage endpoint. `type` is `s3` (requires Coolify >= v4.3.0), or `sftp`, `ftps`, or `webdav` (requires Coolify >= v4.7.0).

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "s3_access_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "s3_secret_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "coolify_s3_storage" "example" {
  name        = "my-s3-storage"
  description = "S3 storage for database backups"
  endpoint    = "https://s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com"
  bucket      = "my-coolify-backups"
  region      = "us-east-1"
  key         = var.s3_access_key
  secret      = var.s3_secret_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint` (String) S3-compatible endpoint URL (e.g. `https://s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com`). Coolify validates this with its SafeWebhookUrl rule: private, loopback, and most internal hostnames (including Docker DNS names such as `coolify-minio`) are rejected unless the Coolify instance explicitly allowlists them. Use a public HTTPS endpoint for API-managed storages.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) S3 access key, or the username for `sftp`, `ftps`, and `webdav`. Sensitive; Coolify may omit it on read unless the API token can read sensitive fields. Preserve the value in configuration after import.
- `name` (String) A friendly name for the S3 storage.

### Optional

- `bucket` (String) S3 bucket name. Required when type is `s3` or omitted. Do not set it for `sftp`, `ftps`, or `webdav`. Coolify rejects the field for those types.
- `description` (String) Optional description of the S3 storage. Omitting the attribute later does not clear the stored Coolify value.
- `is_usable` (Boolean) Whether Coolify marks this storage as usable. Defaults to `false`. Connection validation can update this on the server.
- `private_key_uuid` (String) SFTP only. UUID of a team private key used to log in. Requires Coolify >= v4.7.0. On older instances the provider keeps the value in state and does not send it. Removing the attribute sends null so Coolify switches back to the password in `secret`. After import, leave the imported UUID in configuration or the next apply clears the key.
- `region` (String) S3 region (for example `us-east-1`). Required when type is `s3` or omitted. Do not set it for `sftp`, `ftps`, or `webdav`. Coolify stores `us-east-1` as a placeholder for those types.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) S3 secret key, or the password for `ftps`, `webdav`, and password-based `sftp`. Omit it when `type` is `sftp` and `private_key_uuid` is set. Sensitive; Coolify may omit it on read unless the API token can read sensitive fields. Preserve the value in configuration after import. Set it again in the same change that removes `private_key_uuid`, because Coolify clears the saved password when a key is used.
- `skip_tls_verification` (Boolean) S3 only. Do not check the endpoint TLS certificate. Use only for a self-signed or private CA. Requires Coolify >= v4.7.0. On older instances the provider keeps the value in state and does not send it.
- `type` (String) Storage type. `s3` (default when omitted), `sftp`, `ftps`, or `webdav`. A type other than `s3` requires Coolify >= v4.7.0. Changing type replaces the storage. Coolify cannot change the protocol in place. On older instances the provider keeps the value in state and does not send it.
- `use_path_style_endpoint` (Boolean) S3 only. Use path-style URLs (`endpoint/bucket`) instead of virtual-hosted-style (`bucket.endpoint`). Do not set it for `sftp`, `ftps`, or `webdav`. Requires Coolify >= v4.5.1. On create, leaving it unset lets Coolify choose: false for Alibaba Cloud OSS, Tencent Cloud COS, and Volcengine TOS endpoints, and true for other endpoints. Removing the attribute later does not clear a stored value. On older instances the provider keeps the value in state and does not send it.

### Read-Only

- `sftp_host_key` (String, Sensitive) SFTP host key recorded by Coolify. Read-only.
- `uuid` (String) The unique identifier of the S3 storage.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# NOTE: Import only restores API-readable fields. Keep key and secret in your
# Terraform config before running terraform plan, because Coolify may omit
# them on read/import unless the API token can read sensitive fields.
terraform import coolify_s3_storage.example <s3-storage-uuid>
```
